name: memo
displayName: memo — local memory for AI agents
description: Registers memo — a local-first, long-term memory MCP server — in VS Code agent mode. MLX on Apple Silicon or CPU on Linux. Markdown on disk, no cloud, no API keys.

memo.useInstalledBinary.markdownDescription: Run the already-installed `memo-mcp` binary directly instead of fetching it with `uvx --from mlx-memo`. Enable this if you installed memo with `pipx install mlx-memo` or `uv tool install mlx-memo`.

memo.dataDir.markdownDescription: Directory for memo's store and SQLite index (sets `MEMO_DATA_DIR`). Leave empty to use memo's default per-user directory.

memo.vaultPath.markdownDescription: Path to an Obsidian vault. When set, memories are stored under the vault as markdown (sets `MEMO_VAULT_PATH` and `MEMO_MEMORIES_IN_VAULT`).
